node.statement: Right estimate: put D=(P_{1,n}X)Q_{1,n} and Y=P_{1,n}X. By node 1.2, ||X-D||<=k_co e||X||. Using submultiplicativity and epsilon-associativity exactly as on the left, now with ||Q_{1,n}Q_n-Q_{1,n}||<=delta from node 1.1, one gets ||XQ_n-X||<=||(X-D)Q_n||+||(YQ_{1,n})Q_n-YQ_{1,n}||+||D-X||<=2Bk_co e||X||+[epsilon B^2+(1+epsilon)delta]||Y||+k_co e||X||. Since ||Y||<=2B||X||, this is at most Le||X||.
